```r
n <- 1000
loss_per_foreclosure <- -200000
p <- 0.02 
defaults <- sample( c(0,1), n, prob=c(1-p, p), replace = TRUE)
sum(defaults * loss_per_foreclosure)
#> [1] -3600000
```

```r
})
```

